provenance: User Tiny Colony proposal and manually reviewed correction; controlled response, not an actual provider generation. Frozen before release comparison.

previous_proposal.title: Tiny Colony
previous_proposal.summary: Interactive ant-foraging simulation served by a Python stdlib HTTP server. One nest, 40 ants, food patches, obstacles, and a fading food-trail pheromone field. Tools for placing food, drawing/erasing obstacles. Controls: Pause/Resume, 1×/2×/4× speed, Show Pheromones toggle, Reset with confirmation. Dark earthy theme with amber ants, green food, recognizable nest, translucent pheromone overlay. Mouse and touch input, narrow-screen friendly. Starting scene with two reachable food patches and short barriers. No external dependencies, no database, no save/load.
features: Serve the local simulation (HTML/JS/CSS delivery via Python stdlib HTTP server)
Ant foraging behavior: wandering search, pheromone-following, food pickup, visible carry, nest deposit, pheromone deposition on return, search resume
Food accounting conservation: remaining food + carried food + stored food stays constant when no food is added or reset
Ant navigation around barriers: ants avoid obstacles, cannot cross them, recover from stuck states
Pheromone trails forming and fading over simulation time; Show Pheromones toggle hides overlay without disabling pheromone behavior
Pause/Resume freezes and continues the entire simulation (movement, decay, collection, deposits)
Speed controls (1×/2×/4×) change simulation rate consistently
Food placement (click/tap) and obstacle drawing/erasing (drag); obstacles cannot cover nest, food, or ants; no fully enclosed barriers
Reset with confirmation: cancellation changes nothing; confirmation restores initial colony, food, obstacles, counters, and controls without duplicate animation loops
Touch controls and narrow-screen layout: tools and controls usable on small viewports
out_of_scope: Ant reproduction, combat, rival colonies, weather
risks: Gameplay behavior requires manual play-testing; HTTP checks only prove delivery
Canvas rendering and simulation loop must stay in sync across pause/speed/reset
Touch and mouse event handling must not conflict
Bounded timestep needed to avoid huge jumps after tab inactivity
Pheromone field storage must remain bounded
Reset must cleanly stop and restart the animation loop without duplicates

tasks.title: Project structure and Python server with static file serving
tasks.instructions: Create project directory layout: app.py (server with create_server(host, port) returning HTTPServer, main block with --host/--port), static/ for HTML/CSS/JS, tests/ for Python tests. Implement GET /health -> {"status":"ok"}, GET / -> index.html, GET /static/* -> serve files from static/. Add health and page delivery tests. Ensure server runs on stdlib only (http.server, socketserver, json, pathlib, mimetypes).

tasks.title: Core simulation engine: world, ants, nest, food, obstacles, pheromones
tasks.instructions: In static/js/simulation.js implement: World class with fixed size, nest position, 40 ants, food patches (position, amount), obstacles (grid or segment list), pheromone field (2D array with fade). Ant class: state (searching/returning), position, velocity, carried food flag. Wandering movement with noise. Probabilistic pheromone following (stronger nearby trails favored). Food pickup: remove 1 unit from patch, set carrying=true. Returning: steer toward nest, avoid obstacles (raycast or grid check), deposit pheromone along path. Nest arrival: deposit carried unit, increment stored food, clear carrying, resume searching. Pheromone fade per simulation timestep. Bounded timestep (max dt) for tab-inactivity safety. Obstacle collision: ants slide along or bounce, with stuck recovery (random wiggle after N stuck frames). No enclosed barrier validation in this version (user draws short segments). Cap ants at 40, pheromone array bounded.

tasks.title: Canvas rendering: terrain, nest, food, ants, pheromone overlay, legend, counters
tasks.instructions: In static/js/render.js implement draw(ctx, world, showPheromones): dark earthy background, nest (distinct shape), food patches (green, size ~ amount), ants (amber, carrying ants visually distinct e.g. brighter/larger), obstacles (dark barrier lines), optional translucent pheromone overlay (amber gradient by intensity). Top-left counters: Stored Food, Remaining Food, Carrying Ants, Total Ants (40). Small legend: ant colors, food, nest, obstacle, pheromone. Tool instructions line. Responsive canvas sizing (CSS size vs device pixels).

tasks.title: UI controls: tool buttons, speed, pause, pheromone toggle, reset with confirmation
tasks.instructions: In static/js/ui.js and static/index.html: Toolbar with labeled buttons - Place Food, Draw Obstacle, Erase Obstacle (radio group, one active). Speed selector: 1×/2×/4× (dropdown or buttons). Pause/Resume button (toggles). Show Pheromones checkbox. Reset button -> confirm dialog (native confirm or custom modal); on confirm, reinitialize world to starting scene (2 food patches, few short barriers, 40 ants at nest, zero stored food, clear pheromones), reset speed to 1×, pause off, pheromones shown, tool = Place Food. Ensure no duplicate requestAnimationFrame loops: single loop reference, cancel on reset before starting new. Controls stacked vertically on narrow screens (CSS flex/grid with media query).

tasks.title: Input handling: mouse and touch for tools, obstacle draw/erase, food placement
tasks.instructions: In static/js/input.js: Track active tool. Place Food: click/tap -> add food patch at world coordinates (clamped, not on nest/obstacle/ant). Draw Obstacle: drag -> add short barrier segments (line segments or grid cells) along path; prevent drawing over nest, existing food, ants. Erase Obstacle: drag -> remove barrier segments intersecting path. Touch: treat single touch as pointer, prevent default scroll on canvas. Coordinate transform from screen to world (account for canvas CSS scale). Tool cursor feedback (crosshair, brush, eraser).

tasks.title: Integration, starting scene, polish, and Python tests
tasks.instructions: Wire simulation, render, ui, input in static/js/main.js: init world with starting scene (nest center, 2 food patches reachable, 3-4 short barrier segments), start animation loop (requestAnimationFrame with timestamp, compute dt = min(now - last, maxDt) * speedMultiplier, step simulation, render). Add CSS polish: dark theme, earthy palette, readable fonts, button states, narrow-screen layout. Write Python tests in tests/test_server.py: test_health, test_root_serves_html, test_static_assets_served. Run tests with python -m pytest or unittest. Verify no console errors.

manual_checks.name: Complete food round trip
steps: Start simulation (unpaused, 1×)
Observe ants leaving nest
Wait for an ant to reach a food patch
Verify ant visually changes to carrying state
Watch ant return to nest
Verify stored food counter increments by 1
Verify ant resumes searching
manual_checks.expected: Ant picks up exactly one food unit, visibly carries it to nest, deposits it (stored food +1), and resumes searching. No food lost or duplicated.

manual_checks.name: Food accounting conservation
steps: Note initial Remaining Food + Stored Food + Carrying Ants (each carrying ant = 1)
Let simulation run for several round trips without adding food or resetting
Periodically sum Remaining Food + Stored Food + Carrying Ants
manual_checks.expected: The sum remains constant throughout. Food is only transferred between patches, ants, and storage.

manual_checks.name: Ants navigate around barriers
steps: Use Draw Obstacle to place a barrier segment between nest and a food patch
Observe ants approaching the barrier
Verify ants do not cross the barrier
Verify ants path around the barrier ends and reach food/nest
manual_checks.expected: Ants treat barriers as solid, slide along or turn away, and successfully navigate around segment ends to complete trips.

manual_checks.name: Pheromone trails form, fade, and toggle
steps: Enable Show Pheromones
Let ants make several food trips
Observe amber trails forming on return paths
Wait and observe trails fading over time
Uncheck Show Pheromones
Verify overlay disappears but ants still follow trails (behavior unchanged)
Re-enable Show Pheromones, verify trails visible again
manual_checks.expected: Trails appear where returning ants deposit pheromone, fade gradually, toggle hides only the visual overlay not the underlying pheromone field.

manual_checks.name: Pause freezes simulation, Resume continues
steps: Run simulation at 1×
Click Pause
Observe: ants stop moving, counters freeze, pheromones stop fading
Wait 5 seconds real time
Click Resume
Observe: simulation continues from exact state
manual_checks.expected: Pause halts all simulation updates (movement, decay, collection, deposits). Resume restores updates without time jump.

manual_checks.name: Speed controls change simulation rate
steps: Set speed to 1×, note ant movement pace and pheromone fade rate
Set speed to 2×, observe roughly double pace
Set speed to 4×, observe roughly quadruple pace
Return to 1×, verify normal pace
manual_checks.expected: All simulation processes (movement, pheromone decay, food pickup/deposit) scale linearly with speed setting.

manual_checks.name: Food placement and obstacle drawing/erasing
steps: Select Place Food, click empty area -> food patch appears
Select Draw Obstacle, drag -> barrier segment appears along drag path
Attempt to draw over nest/food/ant -> barrier not placed there
Select Erase Obstacle, drag over barrier -> barrier removed
Verify ants can now pass through erased gap
manual_checks.expected: Tools work as labeled. Obstacles respect protected entities. Erasing restores passable terrain.

manual_checks.name: Reset cancellation and confirmation
steps: Modify scene: add food, draw barriers, let ants gather stored food
Click Reset, click Cancel in confirmation
Verify nothing changed (stored food, barriers, ants, speed, pause state)
Click Reset, click Confirm
Verify: 40 ants at nest, 2 initial food patches, initial barriers, stored food = 0, speed = 1×, pause off, pheromones shown, tool = Place Food, no duplicate animation loops
manual_checks.expected: Cancellation leaves state untouched. Confirmation fully restores initial scene and controls cleanly.

manual_checks.name: Touch controls and narrow-screen layout
steps: Open in mobile viewport (or resize browser narrow)
Verify toolbar stacks vertically, buttons are tappable
Tap Place Food, tap canvas -> food placed
Tap Draw Obstacle, drag finger -> barrier drawn
Tap Erase Obstacle, drag finger -> barrier erased
Tap Pause/Resume, speed buttons, Show Pheromones, Reset -> all respond
manual_checks.expected: All tools and controls work via touch. Layout adapts to narrow width without horizontal scroll. No hover-only interactions.

request.revision: Keep all features. Use unittest, enforce separated barriers, BFS return paths, one animation loop, bounded substeps, paused reset cancellation and a 60-simulation-second delivery check.
